text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I escort Mejiro Bright to the infirmary
after she
suffers an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but... while I appreciate your
concern,
as you can see, I'm still fit to
run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll not make any progress at all standing
still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get back to training, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get back to training, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'd never thought of it that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall take your word for it,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please tailor tomorrow's training session
so as to
make up for lost time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear... It hurts a little when I stretch
out like
so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sigh... ...As much as it pains me to do this, I shall honor my promise and rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's take things nice and slowly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Overexerting myself in an effort to
recover
sooner would do me more harm
than good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's light stretching pays off,
and she
soon makes up for the lost time.
